title: Disabled Fans Say the Live-Music Industry Can Do Better: ‘We Are Not a Pain in the Ass’
summary: Disabled concertgoers criticize live‑music venues for inadequate ADA compliance and call for better accessibility, saying they are not a burden.
body:
Disabled concertgoers criticize live‑music venues for inadequate ADA compliance and call for better accessibility, saying they are not a burden.

title: B.C. communities bring Halloween to the sidewalks to make trick-or-treating more accessible
summary: Communities in British Columbia are moving Halloween trick‑or‑treating activities onto sidewalks to improve accessibility for children with mobility disabilities.
body:
Communities in British Columbia are moving Halloween trick‑or‑treating activities onto sidewalks to improve accessibility for children with mobility disabilities.

title: Jersey general election accessibility survey launched
summary: Jersey launches an accessibility survey for its general election to identify barriers faced by voters with disabilities and improve voting access.
body:
Jersey launches an accessibility survey for its general election to identify barriers faced by voters with disabilities and improve voting access.

title: General election accessibility survey launched
summary: A survey has been launched to assess the accessibility of general elections for people with disabilities, focusing on polling place accommodations, ballot design, and voting procedures.
body:
A survey has been launched to assess the accessibility of general elections for people with disabilities, focusing on polling place accommodations, ballot design, and voting procedures.
